rationale: Discriminates the failure this gate exists to catch -- a model that ignores the image and answers from text priors -- without going red on a single ambiguous render, which would send us debugging the corpus instead of the engine.

generation.note: Greedy makes the run reproducible; no seed is required and none may be relied on.
generation.max_tokens_note: Raised from 32 on 2026-09-01 by user decision. This model emits reasoning_content before content and reasoning counts against the completion budget: run 0d spent 146 completion tokens to answer '4'. At 32 every item returned finish_reason 'length' with empty content, so the gate went red for a harness reason with no bearing on the model. 512 is the value 0d stopped naturally under. NOT results-driven: no gate item had been scored when this was changed, and the evidence came from an independent run.

scoring.normalisation: lowercase, strip characters outside [a-z0-9 ], collapse and trim whitespace
scoring.match: normalised equality, OR whole-word containment of the answer in the response
scoring.substring_containment: NOT accepted -- 'four' must not be satisfied by 'fourteen'

arm_b_cut_rule.action: an item answered correctly in arm B is CUT from arm A scoring, not scored
arm_b_cut_rule.why: it carries a text prior and is not evidence about the vision path either way
arm_b_cut_rule.reporting: cut ids listed per class; cutting shrinks the set and that cost is reported, never hidden

arm_a_significance.test: one-sided exact binomial vs the item chance

arm_b_requirement.test: one-sided exact binomial vs the item chance
arm_b_requirement.rule: arm B must NOT be significantly above chance

synthetic.aggregation: ALL FOUR classes must pass independently; no averaging across classes

natural.min_retained_rationale: if more than 20 items carry text priors the corpus is compromised and must be rebuilt, not scored
natural.claim_scope: supports a C2 quality statement; it is NOT comparable to production, which has no vision path

chance_provenance.arm: text-only; no image sent, no arm A computed
chance_provenance.value_is: Clopper-Pearson one-sided UPPER bound, not the point estimate
chance_provenance.why: a free-answer corpus has no combinatorial chance level; chance 0.0 makes the exact-binomial arm-B test degenerate, so a single text-only hit would force the class red

chance_provenance_implications.note: these two rules are not the same test -- above-chance asks whether a systematic text prior exists, min_retained asks whether the corpus is compromised -- but the stricter one decides the verdict, and it is stricter than the twenty the min_retained rationale describes

natural.max_tokens_note: User decision 2026-09-01 after the tvqa_34733 localiser. 512 was calibrated on run 0d, a 146-token counting item; free-answer OCR demonstrably needs more. At 512 the watchdog caught a long reasoning excursion mid-cycle and returned 422; at 2048 the reasoning budget is exhausted, the server force-closes, and the model returns the correct answer. Forced-choice sets keep the 512 default. Consequence stated BEFORE the rerun: this is expected to turn natural from RED to PASS, which is why it was a user decision and why both runs must be reported together.

verdict.rule: RED if any synthetic class misses its floor or its significance test, if arm B is above chance anywhere, if retained natural items fall below the minimum, or if natural arm A misses its floor
verdict.reporting: per class always; a set that passes on aggregate while failing a class is a finding, not a pass
verdict.immutability: this file is digest-bound and pre-registered. A threshold changed after seeing model output is a NEW policy version and a NEW run, and both must appear in the evidence.

repetition_422.rule: HTTP 422 with error code repetition_detected is a SCORED MISS in an arm that sent NO image, and remains an ERROR in any arm that sent one
repetition_422.why: the no-image arm exists to measure whether the model can answer without the image; degenerating is that measurement, and ember refusing to return the partial is the engine working. Treating it as a request error discarded a whole 100-item calibration over the one item that demonstrated the point best
repetition_422.not_symmetric: degenerating WITH the image present is a real failure and must not be recorded as a wrong answer
